items.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>This study presents the results of interdisciplinary research on a unique osseous projectile point bearing visible traces of a black, pitch-like substance, discovered in 2022 during an underwater visual survey of the Žeimena River bed in eastern Lithuania. Radiocarbon dating of the adhesive residue and a suite of physicochemical analyses were applied to investigate the artefact and its hafting material. Gas Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry (GC–MS) and Attenuated Total Reflectance Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy (ATR–FTIR) analyses support the identification of the organic substance as birch bark tar. Zooarchaeology by Mass Spectrometry (ZooMS) provided insights into the animal origin of the raw material used in the artifact’s manufacture. Detailed microscopic analysis provided insights into the final stages of manufacture and the hafting procedure. The results are discussed in relation to current knowledge of Mesolithic osseous projectile points in Europe.</jats:p>
items.summary: 《立陶宛Garnys 1遗址出土的早期中石器时代骨质投射器尖：东波罗的海平原罕见发现的多学科分析》：研究对2022年在立陶宛东部Žeimena河床水下调查中发现的带黑色沥青状物质痕迹的骨质投射器尖开展多学科分析，通过放射性碳测年与理化分析鉴定黏附物为桦树皮焦油，并借助ZooMS和显微分析探讨原料来源与装柄工艺，值得关注中石器时代欧洲骨质投射器研究者的阅读。
items.title: An early mesolithic osseous projectile point from the Garnys 1 site, Lithuania: interdisciplinary analysis of a rare find from the East Baltic Plain

items.abstract: The emergence of anatomically modern humans was a pivotal event in evolution. It has been dealt with in hundreds of books and an infi nite number of articles. I have been tackling this problem for more than half a century, especially in the last 15–20 years, after the results of sequencing Neanderthal and Denisovan DNA had become available. My conclusions will be outlined in two articles. The fi rst one focuses on the evolution of H. erectus in Africa, culminating in the emergence of early Homo sapiens , while in the second one the emergence of H. s. neanderthalensis in Europe and H. s. denisovensis in Central Asia, and the convergent evolution of local H. erectus populations toward H. sapiens in East and Southeast Asia will be examined. Homo sapiens sapiens originated in the process of the dispersal of anatomically modern humans from Africa 60–30 thousand years ago and their admixture with H. s. neanderthalensis in Europe, Denisovans (the informal term is Homo s. denisovensis ) in Central Asia, and early modern humans, informally termed Homo s. orienthalensis , who had originated in China and Southeast Asia.
items.summary: 《非洲解剖学现代人（智人）的起源》：作者结合尼安德特人与丹尼索瓦人DNA测序结果，梳理非洲直立人演化至早期智人的过程，并预告后续将讨论欧洲尼安德特人、中亚丹尼索瓦人及东亚、东南亚本地直立人向智人的趋同演化，以及6万至3万年前智人走出非洲后的融合。
items.title: The Origin of Anatomically Modern Humans ( Homo sapiens ) in Africa

items.summary: 《日本静冈县富士市伊原群鹭野田组中更新世鱼类化石》：该研究报道了伊原群鹭野田组中更新世的鱼类化石，作者为桥本实笃、西冈雄一郎、横山贤治与朱利安·勒格朗，发表于Paleontological Research。
items.title: Fish fossils from the Middle Pleistocene Saginota Formation of the Ihara Group, Fuji, Shizuoka, Japan

items.abstract: Our studies of the relationship between prehistoric humans and their environment included the taphocenotic analysis of large mammal faunas from key Paleolithic sites in the upper Anui River basin, northwestern Altai. Faunal assemblages from the Denisova, Kaminnaya, and Okladnikov caves and the Ust-Karakol open-air site were examined. Their stratigraphic sequences span a wide chronological interval from 300 to 10 ka BP. To assess the structure of animal resources available to prehistoric humans, quantitative ratios of 17 taxa or groups of taxa were analyzed, representing carnivores (Carnivora), proboscideans (Proboscidea), odd-toed ungulates (Perissodactyla), and artiodactyls (Artiodactyla). The distribution of bones of large herbivorous mammals suggests that the primary bioresources for the earliest humans in the Anui basin were Siberian ibex, argali, bison, and horses. Other preferably hunted mammals were antelopes (dzeren and saiga), as well as deer (red and roe deer). Woolly rhinoceros was hunted less frequently. The main competitors of Paleolithic humans in consuming animal bioresources were large predators (hyena and wolf), and the main rivals in cave shelters were bears and hyenas.
authors: Agadjanian A.K., Shunkov M.V., Kozlikin M.B.
items.summary: 《阿尔泰阿努伊河流域旧石器时代人类利用生物资源的结构》：研究通过分析杰尼索瓦洞、卡明纳亚洞、奥克拉德尼科夫洞和乌斯季-卡拉科尔露天遗址的动物群组合，探讨距今30万至1万年间早期人类可利用的动物资源构成，指出西伯利亚北山羊、盘羊、野牛和马是主要生物资源，鬣狗和狼是主要竞争者，熊和鬣狗是洞穴住所的主要争夺者，适合关注旧石器时代人类生态与动物考古的读者。
items.title: The Structure of Bioresources Exploited by Paleolithic Humans in the Anui River Basin, Altai

items.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Ground squirrels (Rodentia, Sciuridae, Xerinae, Marmotini) diversified on the central Great Plains of North America during the Pliocene and Early Pleistocene, likely associated with the emplacement of modern-type grasslands. This diversity of Pliocene–Early Pleistocene ground squirrels is well documented from southwestern Kansas but is not well understood farther north and east on the Great Plains, a region that was periodically glaciated during the Early Pleistocene. Here, I report a composite assemblage of at least 10 species of ground squirrels from three Early Pleistocene (late Blancan) faunas in northeastern Nebraska, with eight species co-occurring at Big Springs. These fossils document early regional occurrence of the crown clade within
                    <jats:italic>Marmota</jats:italic>
                    Blumenbach; late regional persistence of the giant ground squirrel,
                    <jats:italic>Paenemarmota barbouri</jats:italic>
                    (Hibbard and Schultz); the earliest record of
                    <jats:italic>Poliocitellus</jats:italic>
                    Howell; the earliest record of
                    <jats:italic>Urocitellus</jats:italic>
                    Obolenskij from the Great Plains; early appearance of a small prairie dog–like ground squirrel, likely ?
                    <jats:italic>Cynomys andersoni</jats:italic>
                    Goodwin, otherwise only known from the early to middle Pleistocene of Colorado; and the presence of a distinctive ground squirrel described herein as
                    <jats:italic>Nebraskocitellus voorhiesi</jats:italic>
                    new genus new species. Overall, these findings document high regional diversity of ground squirrels during the Early Pleistocene, indicate the transitional composition of Early Pleistocene assemblages, and suggest that “modernization” of the ground squirrel assemblage on the central Great Plains began earlier in the northeast than documented in southwestern Kansas.
                  </jats:p>
                  <jats:p>
                    UUID:
                    <jats:uri xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xlink:href="http://zoobank.org/8e35d11a-9ea6-4269-96e3-2be783de48a9">http://zoobank.org/8e35d11a-9ea6-4269-96e3-2be783de48a9</jats:uri>
                  </jats:p>
items.summary: 《内布拉斯加东北部早更新世多样化的地松鼠，包括一新属新种》：该研究报告了内布拉斯加东北部三个早更新世动物群中至少10种地松鼠的复合组合，其中Big Springs有8种共存，并描述了新属新种Nebraskocitellus voorhiesi，记录了多个类群的最早或晚期出现，表明该地区早更新世地松鼠多样性高、组合具过渡性，且地松鼠组合的“现代化”在东北部比…
items.title: Diverse Early Pleistocene ground squirrels from northeastern Nebraska including a new genus and species

items.abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Hydroclimate in Portugal is influenced by the North Atlantic subtropical high‐pressure system (the Azores High) and by internal climate modes, most prominently the North Atlantic Oscillation, which may shift in position and/or intensity due to anthropogenic climate change. The development of high‐resolution paleoclimate records from sites in Portugal is critical for providing baseline climate estimates, including hydroclimate variability, for better constraining climate model predictions under future warming scenarios. Here, we present a near‐annually resolved composite stable carbon isotope (δ
                    <jats:sup>13</jats:sup>
                    C) and oxygen isotope (δ
                    <jats:sup>18</jats:sup>
                    O) time series from three stalagmites from two proximally located caves in the Algarve region of southern Portugal. U/Th dating indicates that our record spans the last millennium, with a short hiatus at ~1450 CE. During the last millennium, the stalagmite record shows coherence with regional sea surface temperature, Northern Hemisphere air temperature, and the North Atlantic Oscillation, demonstrating that the stalagmite proxies broadly reflect hydroclimate. Hydroclimate during the Medieval Climate Anomaly was relatively dry/warm and generally more variable than modern conditions and transitioned to an overall wetter/cooler early Little Ice Age with similar hydroclimate variability. From ~1650 to 1700 CE, conditions in southern Portugal became increasingly dry/warm, with hydroclimate remaining fairly stable from 1700 CE to the present.
                  </jats:p>
authors: Alaina Chormann, Alan D. Wanamaker, Diana Thatcher, David P. Gillikin, Yemane Asmerom, Victor Polyak, Caroline C. Ummenhofer, Frederico Tátá Regala, Anouk Verheyden, Suzanne Ankerstjerne, Rhawn F. Denniston
items.summary: 《近千年南葡萄牙水文气候：基于近年度分辨石笋记录的研究》：该研究利用葡萄牙南部阿尔加维地区两处邻近洞穴的三根石笋，建立近年度分辨的碳氧稳定同位素序列，重建过去千年水文气候，并探讨其与区域海温、北半球气温及北大西洋涛动的关联，值得关注以了解该地区中世纪气候异常、小冰期及现代水文气候变化的自然背景。
items.title: Southern Portugal hydroclimate of the last millennium from near‐annually resolved speleothem records

items.summary: 《埃塞俄比亚梅尔卡昆图雷的黑曜石利用：从奥杜韦文化到晚期石器时代》：该研究考察了当地从奥杜韦文化至晚期石器时代的黑曜石利用情况，适合关注早期石器技术、原料获取与东非考古的读者阅读。
items.title: OBSIDIAN USE AT MELKA KUNTURE (ETHIOPIA), FROM THE OLDOWAN TO THE LATE STONE AGE

items.abstract: We describe a glass intaglio with an impressed image, excavated by the International Russian-Abkhazian Archaeological Expedition from the Russian Academy of Sciences Institute of Archaeology and the Academy of Sciences of Abkhazia Institute for the Humanities at the Markula settlement in 2022. The archaeological context and iconography of the image are described. The standing fi gure in the center is interpreted as that of Harpocrates (Zeus Kasios) wearing the hemhem crown, holding a pomegranate in his right hand. In his left hand, there is a branch, for which a child or pygmy reaches. Regarding the origin of this cult, some experts believe that during the Ptolemaic era, Zeus Kasios was a Near Eastern reflex of the Greek Zeus, identified with Baal-Zaphon. The iconographic type described in this study, also known as Harpocrates of Pelusia, was related to new Egyptian interpretations. The god’s name—Harpocrates, or Zeus Kasios—refl ects the blend of his functions as a solar deity and patron of seafarers with his prophetic gift, highlighting his youthful appearance known from graphic and written sources. The closest parallels are found among engraved gems and coins of the 3rd century AD. As compared to them, the image on the Markula intaglio is mirrored, making it impossible to establish the production technique with certainty. Possibly, an impression was made on softened glass with a ceramic or metal mold, copying the image on a currently unknown gem. After cooling, the image’s details were fi nished using cold engraving. The analysis of the glass’s composition suggests that the intaglio was made at an Egyptian workshop. The intaglio likely arrived in the region via trade contacts or with a Roman legionary. It is concluded that the discovery of this ornament not merely refl ects the syncretic nature of Roman religion, but also suggests that the local population was familiar with the diversity of the provincial cults of the Roman Empire.
authors: Stolyarova E.K., Chernenko V.G., Yurkov V.G., Sakania S.M., Trebeleva G.V.
items.summary: 《阿布哈兹马尔库拉出土的描绘哈波克拉底（宙斯·卡西奥斯）的玻璃凹雕》：该研究描述2022年马尔库拉遗址出土的玻璃凹雕，分析其考古背景与图像，将中央站立人物释为戴hemhem冠、右手持石榴的哈波克拉底（宙斯·卡西奥斯），并探讨其与3世纪AD宝石和钱币的关联及埃及作坊来源。
items.title: A Glass Intaglio Depicting Harpocrates (Zeus Kasios) from Markula, Abkhazia

items.abstract: We describe a partially preserved iron shield discovered in the Uybat steppe, Republic of Khakassia, in 2019. Measuring 65 cm in diameter and weighing over 4 kg, it is fl at, rounded, and riveted from 14 identical segmentshaped iron plates. The edge is decorated with a pattern of fi ne serrations. In the central part, the plates are joined by a two-piece boss with a narrow belt-clip located on the inside of the shield. The perimeter of the boss on the front side is decorated with rectangular cutouts and openwork crescents with protrusions. Graphic reconstructions of the outer and inner surfaces of the shield are presented. Variants of its use in combat and marching positions are discussed. The shield was made at one of the Near Eastern workshops. An exact parallel is an iron shield excavated from a medieval settlement of Beshtam-Kala on the Zhana-Darya River, the Aral region, which had been destroyed during the Mongol conquest of northeastern Khorezm in the early 1200s. We propose that the Uybat specimen was used during the feud between Genghis Khan’s ancestors, in which peoples of the Altai-Sayan belonging to the Great Khan’s ulus were embroiled. Its owner could have been a Kyrgyz or Mongolian warrior fi ghting in Tutuha’s army, which in 1293 conquered all the “Five Tribes” of the Yenisei Kyrgyz. The fi nd evidences political and socio-economic ties between major regions of Central Asia and southern Siberia during the High Middle Ages.
items.summary: 《哈卡斯-米努辛斯克地区出土的一件蒙古时代铁盾》：该研究描述2019年在哈卡斯共和国乌伊巴特草原发现的一件部分保存的铁盾，直径65厘米、重逾4公斤，由14块相同扇形铁板铆接而成，边缘饰细锯齿纹，中心有带窄带夹的两件式盾凸，并给出内外表面复原图、讨论实战与行军使用方式，认为其产自近东作坊，与阿拉尔地区贝什塔姆-卡拉遗址出土铁盾高度相似，或为1293年图图哈军…
items.title: A Mongolian Age Iron Shield from the Khakass-Minusinsk Region

items.abstract: This study provides archaeological support for written evidence on Jurchen road stations along highways connecting towns, including those in Primorye. The Eastern Xia state used the advanced Jin system of land and water routes between the southern and northern parts of the country. Capital cities, too, had to be connected by roads. The location of the Southern and Upper capitals of the state, identifi ed with the Chengzihoushancheng and Kaiyuan settlements, respectively, had been known, but until recently it had been impossible to locate the road connecting them. Findings of excavations at the Jurchen settlement of Olenevod, with the identifi cation of topographic features and parallels among North Korean and Chinese sites, suggest that it was a road station on the highway between capital cities. Structural characteristics of administrative and residential buildings are described, and new features in tile and stucco decoration are revealed. For the fi rst time, the spatial structure of a new type of medieval site was reconstructed. The location of the road station on the bank of the Razdolnaya River may be due to the fact that it was built at the transport interchange between riverine and land routes connecting the capital cities of the Eastern Xia state. The characteristic topographic features of the site shed light on the function of small Jurchen settlements located in river valleys. These settlements may provide reference points for reconstructing land routes.
items.summary: 《东夏国上京的驿站》：该研究为女真道路驿站提供了考古证据，通过奥列涅沃德遗址发掘，结合地形特征及中朝遗址对比，确认其为东夏国都城间干道上的驿站，并重建了新型中世纪遗址的空间结构，揭示了河谷小型女真聚落的功能，值得关注。
items.title: A Road Station in the Upper Capital of the Eastern Xia State

items.abstract: We introduce finds from burial 3 at Khuzhir-Nuge-9 in the Olkhon area. Data on the location, above-ground burial structure (oval pavement ~3.5 m in diameter), grave (oval, 37 cm deep pit), funerary rite (inhumation on the right side with flexed legs, head oriented toward the north, burial strewn with ocher), and grave goods are provided. Clusters of tools and separate stone and bone artifacts, found in different parts of the grave, are described. Typical items include a robust bone tool, an end-scraper, microblades, and retouched and unretouched flakes made from jasper, chalcedony, flint, etc. The most expressive find is a miniature bait made from chert and shaped like a fish. The distribution area of stone figurines of fish in the Baikal area is outlined, their dates are provided, and opinions about their function are cited. Experts view these peculiar items as fishing baits. On the basis of the radiocarbon date of the burial and other sites on Lake Baikal shore, we conclude that such baits were used in this area from the Early Neolithic to the Middle Neolithic, i.e., in the 6th and 5th millennia BC.
items.summary: 《贝加尔湖岸边一座随葬微型鱼形钓饵的早期新石器时代墓葬》：该研究介绍了奥尔洪地区胡日尔-努格-9号墓地第3号墓葬的发现，包括墓葬位置、地上结构、墓坑、葬式及随葬品，其中最引人注目的是一件燧石制成的微型鱼形钓饵，并梳理了贝加尔地区石鱼雕像的分布、年代与功能观点，依据放射性碳测年推断此类钓饵使用于公元前6至5千年的新石器时代早中期，适合关注史前渔猎技术与贝加尔…
items.title: An Early Neolithic Burial with a Miniature Fish-Shaped Bait on the Shore of Lake Baikal

items.abstract: This article describes archaeological artifacts from the necropolises of Chersonesos with regard to their historical and cultural relevance. Based on an extensive sample, the authors classify the principal groups of fi nds, explore the semantics of grave goods, and reconstruct the system of funerary ritual practices within the context of cultural values and the related worldview. Focus is made on the cultural meaning of the most numerous and informative artifacts, the most typical of which are coins, ceramic oil lamps, bronze mirrors, and golden wreaths. Using semiotic and hermeneutic approaches, related images and ideas as parts of the ancient culture are reconstructed. The fi ndings offer insight into the system of beliefs shared by people of the Northern Pontic from 400 BC to 300 AD.
items.summary: 《切尔松尼斯墓地出土文物作为历史文化资料：文化含义解读》：该研究基于大量样本对切尔松尼斯墓地出土文物进行分类，探讨随葬品的语义并重建丧葬仪式实践体系，重点解读钱币、陶油灯、青铜镜和金冠等文物的文化含义，借助符号学与诠释学方法还原公元前400年至公元300年北黑海地区人群的信仰体系，适合关注古典考古与丧葬文化的读者。
items.title: Artifacts from the Necropolises of Chersonesos as a Historical and Cultural Source: An Interpretation of Cultural Meanings

items.abstract: To clarify biological ties of the Early Iron Age Bulan-Koba people of the Altai Mountains, craniometric analysis of three chronological subgroups was carried out: Ust-Edigan (200 BC to 100 AD), Bely Bom (100–350 AD), and KokPash (350–450 AD). The respective trait combinations could have been affected by contacts with other groups of Asiatic steppe nomads during the 300 BC to 500 AD interval. Morphological differences at the within-group level were evaluated using the t -test and F -test for independent observations. Canonical discriminant analysis was carried out using Scythian-Saka and Xiongnu-Sarmatian Age samples from the Volga-Ural region, Southern Urals, Kazakhstan, Central Asia, and Siberia. Diachronic analysis of the Bulan-Koba group reveals no breaks in biological continuity. During the Xiongnu-Sarmatian Age, people with western Eurasian features migrated to the Altai from other areas of Central Asia. The principal autochthonous trait combination was related to the Southern Eurasian Formation with Caucasoid admixtures from Western Central Asia. Over the entire span of the Bulan-Koba culture, its ties were directed eastward, mainly to Xinjiang, as well as Tuva and Mongolia. In female part of the series, these ties were limited to Xinjiang and Tuva. Minor changes occurred only at the Bely Bom stage, when the autochthonous component prevailed. At the Late Kok-Pash stage, the eastern vector is not traceable anymore. Judging by western trait combinations, ties at that stage were likely with Southern Urals and Trans-Urals.
items.summary: 《匈奴—萨尔马特时期阿尔泰山地区人群的颅骨亲缘关系》：该研究通过颅骨测量分析阿尔泰山布兰-科巴文化三个时间亚组，探讨其与欧亚草原游牧人群的生物联系，发现该群体生物连续性未中断，且不同阶段存在东西方不同方向的联系变化，适合关注欧亚草原考古与人群迁徙的读者阅读。
items.title: Cranial Affinities of the Altai Mountains Population During the Xiongnu-Sarmatian Age

authors: Molodin V.I., Polosmak N.V., Kudinova M.A., Komissarov S.A.
items.summary: 《东方遇见西方：林梅村教授与他的丝绸之路（庆贺七十华诞）》：该文由莫洛金等学者撰写，围绕林梅村教授的丝绸之路研究展开评述，适合关注丝路考古与中西文化交流的读者了解其学术贡献。
items.title: East Meets West: Professor Lin Meicun and his Silk Road (Marking his 70th birthday)

items.abstract: New folkloric data collected in Maharashtra, India, have changed our views of the ancient ethnoastronomy of South Asia. Previous reconstructions of beliefs about celestial objects were nearly exclusively based on the comparison of data on Northern and Central Eurasia with those on the New World. Motifs relating to Ursa Major , one of the most important constellations in folk astronomy, are described. An attempt is made to assess the relative age of these beliefs by collating data on Eurasia and America. Four routes whereby people had migrated to the New World are reconstructed, one of these being related to the spread of Algonquin ancestors. Rather than being Paleolithic relicts, parallels between Siberia and India were caused by later northern infl uences on South Asian ethnoastronomy.
items.summary: 《印度新数据背景下的欧亚—美洲民族天文学平行现象》：论文基于印度马哈拉施特拉邦新民俗数据，重新审视南亚古代民族天文学，重点描述与北斗七星相关的母题，并通过欧亚与美洲数据比较评估其相对年代，还重建了四条美洲迁徙路线。适合关注民俗天文学与跨大陆文化传播的读者。
items.title: Eurasian-American Ethnoastronomic Parallels in the Context of New Data from India

items.abstract: This study, based on our 2024 field data, describes tombstones with Russian inscriptions at the Muslim cemetery Kunti-baba on the southeastern Ustyurt Plateau, Karakalpak Region, Republic of Uzbekistan. Our objective is to view them as part of the history of migrants to the Aral Sea region—Ural Cossack Old Believers. We describe several tombstones without Christian symbols but with Muslim decorative motifs. Their connection with the history of the group is discussed, suggesting that the Cossack colonization of the area gave rise to new ethno-cultural and ethno-confessional interactions. Cases of religious conversion were exceptional. Coexisting with native Karakalpaks and Adai Kazakhs, Ural Cossacks preserved their language, writing, names, and military ranks, which marked their ethnic identity.
authors: Babajanov B.M., Djumashev A.M., Saparniyazov A.T.
items.summary: 《19世纪末至20世纪初乌拉尔哥萨克人在咸海地区的历史：作为族群标识的教派标记》：基于2024年田野资料，考察乌兹别克斯坦昆蒂巴巴穆斯林墓地中带俄文铭文、无基督教符号却有穆斯林装饰纹样的墓碑，探讨乌拉尔哥萨克旧礼仪派移民的族群与宗教互动，值得关注。
items.title: From the History of the Late 19th–Early 20th Century Ural Cossacks in the Aral Sea region: Confessional Markers as Ethnic Attributes

items.abstract: This study attempts to reconstruct migration routes to Western Siberia and identify source regions on the basis of analysis of “Cossack” baptismal crosses larger than 52 mm by 48 mm. Their importance stems from the fact that Cossacks played a key role in the colonization of Siberia. The term “Cossack baptismal cross” is known from the notebook of A.P. Serov, a foundry master from Krasnoye Selo—a document used by many experts in sacred pendants. A representative database was compiled to conduct a comparative analysis of the geographic distribution of these items. It includes information on baptismal crosses from the State Catalog of the Russian Federation Museum Fund, as well as staurographic collections from the Novosibirsk, Omsk, and Irkutsk regions. The use of a standardized classifi cation method made it possible to conduct a statistical analysis to determine the geographic distribution of various types of crosses. A trend was identifi ed showing a decrease in typological diversity with increasing distance from the central regions of Russia toward the periphery. Regions identifi ed as sources of migration have been determined. In particular, among the baptismal crosses found at Modern Age cemeteries in Western Siberia, certain types have been identifi ed whose origins are linked to traditional Old Believer centers in Russia and specifi c central regions. In this context, the baptismal cross can be viewed as a confessional marker and a new source for studying migration processes. In terms of dimensions, not a single cross (among more than 1500) matched those described in Serov’s notebook. Apparently, rather than being a universal reference, this document is a sample limited in space and time.
items.summary: 《大型洗礼十字架（“哥萨克十字架”）作为重建西西伯利亚移民路线的资料》：该研究通过分析尺寸超过52毫米×48毫米的“哥萨克”洗礼十字架，尝试重建通往西西伯利亚的移民路线并识别来源地区，发现远离俄罗斯中部向边缘地带延伸时类型多样性递减，部分十字架类型可追溯至旧礼仪派传统中心及特定中部地区，从而将洗礼十字架视为信仰标记与研究移民过程的新资料；适合关注西伯利亚殖…
items.title: Large Baptismal Crosses (“ Cossack Crosses ”) as a Source for Reconstructing Migration Routes to Western Siberia

items.abstract: Sanctuaries of various ranks are one of the means whereby traditional worldview and ritual practices of Ob Ugrians are translated. Especially informative are those situated in contact zones between Mansi and Khanty residence areas such as the one around Lake Balbanty in the Berezovsky District of Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug–Yugra, an area sacred to both the Lyapin Mansi and the Synya Khanty. On the basis of our 2023 survey, we describe two sanctuaries and their history. The fi rst one relates to Mansi mythological characters—the Chokhryn-Oyka deity and the menkv forest spirits. Other northwestern Siberian places devoted to them are briefl y described, too. The second sanctuary is related to the patron of the reindeer-breeders of northern Urals_Kevvur-khu-akem-iki. Its central feature is a large fi r tree with the deity’s mask carved on its trunk. Information about two other places where Kevvur-khu-akem-iki is venerated by the Synya Khanty is provided. The structure of ritual platforms and the way fi gures of patron-spirits are rendered are more suggestive of the Mansi tradition, whose typical features are structures made of wooden statues supported by a horizontal bar, and masks carved on trunks. The revival of the tradition venerating Ugric deities at Lake Balbanty was triggered by a private initiative and supported by governors of the two federal okrugs. Hopefully, those sanctuaries will be preserved, marking the joint ritual practices of two local groups of Ob Ugrians.
items.summary: 《巴尔班特湖畔的鄂毕乌戈尔人圣所》：论文基于2023年考察，描述了两处圣所及其历史，一处关联曼西神话中的乔赫林-奥伊卡神与门克夫森林精灵，另一处关联北乌拉尔驯鹿牧人守护神凯夫武尔-胡-阿克姆-伊基，并分析其仪式平台结构与神像表现方式更接近曼西传统。该研究有助于了解曼西与汉特人接触地带共享的祭祀实践及乌戈尔神祇崇拜的复兴。
items.title: Ob Ugrian Sanctuaries on Lake Balbanty

items.abstract: The article outlines the results of long-term ethnographic field studies in the Hà Giang Province of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, focusing on the small ethnic group Bo Y, which has retained the foundations of traditional culture. The objective is to assess the Bo Y funerary practices. Original findings bearing on the traditional Bo Y ideas of life and death are introduced. Rituals of animal sacrifice relating to the ancestor cult are described. Despite all the transformations, such rituals remain necessary for regulating social relations, which do not end after the person’s death. Under modern conditions, they acquire a new form while preserving the traditional content—maintaining the continuity between the living and the dead and making social life more harmonious. Bo Y traditions in north Vietnam and southwest China, where the large part of this people lives, are compared. It is concluded that the stability of the Bo Y ritual system contributes to the maintenance of cultural identity, securing the unity and integrity of this small ethnic group.
items.summary: 《越南布依族人的精灵祭祀葬礼：完成未竟之事》：该文基于在越南河江省的长期民族志田野调查，考察布依族葬礼实践、生死观及与祖先崇拜相关的动物献祭仪式，并比较越南北部与中国西南的布依族传统，指出仪式虽形式更新却保留传统内涵，有助于维系文化认同与族群团结。
items.title: The Cúng Yêu Tinh Funerary Rite Among the Bố Y People in Vietnam: Finishing the Unfi nished

items.abstract: To assess the origins of the modern Western Siberian populations, measurements of 30 recent male cranial samples from that territory and 56 medieval ones from Siberia, Southwestern Central Asia, Kazakhstan, and the Volga–Ural area were processed using canonical variate analysis, and Mahalanobis distances corrected for sample size were calculated. The distance matrix was subjected to nonmetric multidimensional scaling and cluster analysis. Ties with modern groups are the most evident in people associated with the Srostki culture of northwestern Altai, Ryolka and Ust-Ishim cultures, Mongolian Age dwellers of Baraba, Gorny Altai, and the lower Tom, and the Yenisei Kyrgyz. Biological differentiation in Southern and Western Siberia is related to language—Ugric, Samoyedic, and Turkic speaking groups show signifi cant differences with regard to their cranial characteristics. Ugric samples differ much sharper than do Samoyedic or Turkic ones. Comparison with medieval samples provides no clues as to the origin of Ugrians. The southern Khanty attribution of Ryolka culture is not supported. Various groups of Selkups may have originated from Mongolic Age people of Baraba or from those of Ryolka and Ust-Ishim cultures. The cranial characteristics of Nenets are typologically Southern Siberian rather than Uralic, and they resemble Turks. The difference between northern Samoyeds and Selkups is likely due to a complex composition and wide geographic distribution of the proto-Samoyedic community. Selkup roots of the Tom Tatars and the Eastern Central Asiatic tendency of Beltyr Khakas are revealed, and the Yenisei Kyrgyz roots of Kachi Khakas are demonstrated. In contrast to their linguistic isolation, Kets display no cranial specifi city.
items.summary: 《基于颅骨测量数据的西西伯利亚现代人群起源：第一部分——分类及与中世纪群体的联系》：该研究通过30组现代男性颅骨样本与56组中世纪样本的典型变量分析、马氏距离及聚类分析，探讨西西伯利亚现代人群与中世纪群体的亲缘关系，涉及乌戈尔、萨莫耶德和突厥语族人群的生物学分化，并检验了汉特人、塞尔库普人、涅涅茨人等群体的起源假说，适合关注西伯利亚人群历史与体质人类学的读…
items.title: The Origin of the Modern Populations of Western Siberia, Based on Craniometric Data. Part I: Classification and Ties with Medieval Groups

items.abstract: On the basis of tombstones at rural cemeteries Dubrovino, Berdskoye, Chingis, Zavyalovo, and Spirino in the northern Upper Ob region, we address the provincial funerary culture of the late Russian Empire. We collate inscriptions on tombstones with parish registers from archival sources, sometimes identifying the buried persons’ names and their parents’ membership of the clerical estate. Detailed descriptions of tombstones, manufacturing techniques, and decoration are provided, and their typology is proposed. Most rural specimens are marble and resemble urban counterparts in type, decoration, and symbolism. The status of rural tombstones matches that of the respective villages. Most of these are either located on the Old Moscow Highway (Dubrovino), or were economically important on the regional scale, or were situated at river crossings (Berdskoye, Chingis, Spirino). We conclude that tombstones of the Upper Ob are informative with regard to the provincial social structure of the Russian Empire of the 1800s and early 1900. At most cemeteries, tombstones are rare and belong to wealthy members of rural communities.
items.summary: 《19世纪至20世纪初上鄂毕河北部乡村墓地的墓碑》：该研究依据杜布罗维诺、别尔德斯科耶、钦吉斯、扎维亚洛沃和斯皮里诺等乡村墓地的墓碑，结合档案中的教区登记簿，考察晚期俄罗斯帝国的外省丧葬文化，提供墓碑形制、制作技术与装饰的详细描述及类型划分，并指出这些墓碑多属乡村社区中的富裕成员，对上鄂毕河地区19世纪至20世纪初的社会结构研究具有参考价值。
items.title: Tombstones of the 19th and Early 20th Century at Rural Cemeteries on the Northern Upper Ob
